# HiAPI GPT Image 2.6 Agent Skill

HiAPI Agent Skill for GPT Image 2.6 Flare and Sunburst — `gpt-image-2.6-flare/text-to-image`,
`gpt-image-2.6-flare/image-to-image`, `gpt-image-2.6-sunburst/text-to-image`,
`gpt-image-2.6-sunburst/image-to-image` — covering text-to-image, image-to-image,
SVG and GIF output, mask/markup edits, local-file uploads, preflight estimates,
`--max-cost` limits, idempotent async tasks, recovery, output download, and
signed auto-updates.

Install: `npx -y github:HiAPIAI/hiapi-gpt-image-2-6-skill -y`

- [Output and recovery](references/output.md): format detection, resume, quality checks
- [Workflow](references/workflow.md): brief to delivery
- [Local files](references/local-files.md): upload and mask rules
- [Upgrade policy](references/upgrade-policy.md): signed auto-update
